'''Glitterglass''' was a type of glass that could be found on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was used to make artistic panes, which [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] thought were garish when she saw some displayed on an art auction.<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>
